The sum is positive because the vertices follow each other counter-clockwise. 𝐴 = 1 2 ∑ 𝑖 = 0 𝑛 − 1 ( 𝑥 𝑖 𝑦 𝑖 + 1 − 𝑥 𝑖 + 1 𝑦 𝑖 ) , ( 𝑥 𝑛 , 𝑦 𝑛 ) = ( 𝑥 0 , 𝑦 0 ) ( 𝑥 𝑖 , 𝑦 𝑖 ) are the vertices in order; the sum without the factor 1 2 is twice the signed area.
